parameters.query:
SELECT call_id, conversation_id, phone, country, duration_secs, start_time
FROM stringee_calls
WHERE conversation_id IS NOT NULL
  AND duration_secs >= 60
  AND answered = 1
  AND (sheet_synced_recording IS NULL OR sheet_synced_recording = 0)
  AND country = 'india'
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 100;
UPDATE stringee_calls SET sheet_synced_recording = 1 WHERE call_id = '{{ $('🔄 Fetch Audio from ElevenLabs').item.json.call_id }}';
